common_name: Green Comet Milkweed / Green-flowered Milkweed / Wand Milkweed
look_here_first: Start with the inflorescence position and flower color. Green comet milkweed has tight greenish flower clusters, often from upper leaf axils, with hoods/corona held compactly; leaves are opposite and relatively broad, and the plant lacks the bright green-white spreading flower look of A. viridis.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: hoods shorter and more compact than in A. viridis

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: follicles slender and erect to ascending

lookalikes.differences: A. viridis has larger green-and-white flowers with broad spreading reflexed corolla lobes and more prominent pale hoods. A. viridiflora is more uniformly greenish and compact-flowered.
